title: anogramma davallioides
intro: Anogramma davallioides, commonly known as the 'davall's lungwort fern', is a species of fern that belongs to the family Anogrammideae. This plant is rich in health benefits, as it has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including fever, bronchitis, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Anogramma davallioides include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant properties, which help to relieve congestion and soothe irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
